_comment: Pricing sourced live from docs/packages.py (hseq-dev repo) via scripts/gen_ladder_pricing.py — not hand-typed. Subcontractor Packs and Builder Packs (Domestic/Light Commercial rungs) are gated on the mastering ledger's findings_at_mastering field, the authoritative per-document record from credentialed mastering, not a raw-source-tree scan: every rung sold self-serve here carries zero outstanding findings, confirmed 2026-09-04. Builder Heavy Commercial/ISO-OFSC (and the whole Consultant channel, not sold on this storefront at all) carry the 69 docs mastered-despite-findings and stay quote-only until that review pass clears (sign-off item B). Registers/ITP/management-systems categories are unrelated products, unchanged. Per docs/ORDER_SITE.md (2026-08-03): purchase and order, one-off only — no subscriptions. The ladder's own subscription prices are not sold here for that reason.
